Problem Statement:
Write a program to reverse the first K elements of a queue using a stack.
Take a queue of integers and an integer K. Reverse the first K elements of the queue. 
Input Description:
First line: elements of the queue (space separated)
Second line: integer K 
Output Description:
Queue after reversing first K elements 
Sample Input:
10 20 30 40 50
3 
Sample Output:
30 20 10 40 50
